components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single flame — solid orange CTA, mono uppercase.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #c53400); color: #fafafa; border: 1px solid #c53400; border-radius: 2px; padding: 14px 26px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a02a00; border-color: #a02a00; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c53400; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — hairline outline, orange on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: rgba(250,250,250,0.65); border: 1px solid #262626; border-radius: 2px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.12s ease-out, color 0.12s ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: #c53400; color: #c53400; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c53400; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Pill chip; PENDING variant carries the orange border.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.24em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-chip-pending { border: 1px solid #c53400; color: #c53400; } .ds-chip-live { border: 1px solid #262626; color: rgba(250,250,250,0.65); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Raised carbon container with hairline and ambient shadow.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #141414; border: 1px solid #262626; border-radius: 12px; padding: 26px; box-shadow: 0 40px 70px -30px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); color: #fafafa; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; }

components.name: Nav
components.description: 64px sticky bar: orange square mark, mono wordmark, dim links.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 64px; padding: 0 32px; background: rgba(13,13,13,0.92); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(250,250,250,0.05); font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-nav-mark { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; background: #c53400; color: #1a0a04; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-nav-word { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.24em; color: #fafafa; } .ds-nav-link { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(250,250,250,0.65); text-decoration: none; margin-left: 12px; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #fafafa; }

narrative.overview: zkPayslip renders payroll the way the STRK20 pool actually holds it: a near-black protocol terminal where amounts sleep in encrypted notes and the only light is a single signal orange reserved for the interactive moment. The world is the STRK20 brand executed at the presentation-craft bar of remlo.xyz — big tight uppercase display, mono technical labels, honest tables, generous narrative rhythm. The visual anti-reference is the generic dark-fintech dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black canvas with carbon raised surfaces; depth by tonal layering and hairlines
One accent hue (signal orange) for every interactive element
Uppercase Space Grotesk display; IBM Plex Mono labels; tabular mono data
Sharp corners: 2px controls, 12px containers, pills only for small chips
Honesty as a design element: hidden-vs-visible tables and PENDING states are content

rules.name: The One Flame Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange is the only hue on any screen; it always means interactive or brand.

rules.name: The Mono Speaks Rule
rules.body: Mono is the technical voice for labels, buttons, and data; prose is never mono.

rules.name: The Flat Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; hover changes border or background, never adds shadow.

dos: Do keep every interactive element in Signal Orange
Do use tabular mono for every number a judge might audit
Do mark unmeasured numbers PENDING and state what stays public
donts: Don't introduce a second hue (no green/red status, no gradients, no glass)
Don't round controls past 2px or containers past 12px
Don't ship pricing, testimonials, logos, or social proof
